svg.title: Score input (mockup)
svg.text: Type a score. The “/max” beside each box shows the most it can be.
Excl: tick a student who did not sit this subject so they are left out of positions.

svg.title: Score divisions (mockup)
svg.text: Decide how marks are split between continuous assessment and exam.
Split it into named parts if you like
Off keeps single-number scores and the parts you already set up.
Show a CA total column on the report card

svg.title: Grading scale (mockup)
svg.text: Keep it customisable: use a preset, then change anything.
✓ No gaps: every mark from 0 to 100 has a grade

svg.title: Report card (A4, printable) (mockup)
svg.text: Ada works hard and leads group tasks. Keep it up.

svg.title: Result checker and print all (mockup)
svg.text: Pick a class, check results, print the whole class in one click.
Tip: choose a class first. In the print window, choose “Save as PDF” to keep a copy.
